name: hud_cmd_dialog_constructor
description: HudCmdDialog::Constructor builds the command dialog child widgets, binds the dialog ZRD controls when available, populates input bind groups, rebuilds command bindings for group 0, hides the prompt panel, clears capture state, resets input transition state, and clears child flags.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the recovered HUD /Gr profile; owner-level tier and linkage acceptance remain governed separately.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40a5b0 constructs HudUiBackground, the command dialog buttons, bind-button lists, set-list widget, concrete navigation button classes, a HudUiTransitionTextPanel prompt member, a direct HudUiPanel description member, and the separate HudCmdDialog::captureState field; loads dialog.zrd/COMMANDS_DIALOG; binds each named command dialog widget and primitive; hides the prompt panel; adds input bind-group titles to the set list; rebuilds command bindings for group 0; clears capture state; resets input transition state; clears child flags; and returns self.

The governed VC5SP3 hud_cmd_dialog_constructor target compiled src/Battlesport/hud.cpp with the recovered /Gr profile and matched retail 0x40a5b0 with zero unmasked byte mismatches; the candidate body has two trailing alignment NOPs trimmed by the target.

It verifies returned self, LoadFromZrd arguments, zero-group set-list state, capture-state clearing, a single rebuild call for group 0, a single child-flag clear call, and clean typed member construction. Binding-list rebuild behavior is covered separately by hud_cmd_dialog_rebuild_command_binding_lists.
